title: 第34章 又来了，没完没了了是吗？
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 旗台虽然只有三十公分不算高，但底下可是水泥地，如果磕着脑袋还是很危险的。失重感袭来，孔垄顿时被吓了一跳。可没等他做出反应，身体就在半空被人稳稳接住。周凯东稳稳将他拖住，微笑着低头看他，孔垄瞪着慌乱的眼睛，不敢与其对视。这一幕看的班上其他新兵目瞪口呆，生怕他们下一秒会出现童话故事里的经典桥段。好在，狗血的一幕并没有发生，大家也不用担心之后会被噩梦困扰了。“给我，起！”周凯东双腿扎稳，腰马合一用力一推。像是从地上竖起一根大号圆木桩似的，就这么硬生生将孔垄又立回旗台边。孔垄站稳后连忙心有余悸的解释：“班长，谢谢嗷。那什么，我，我低血糖犯了。”周凯东淡淡的说了句没事儿，双手慢慢摸向腰间。孔垄松了口气，脑袋刚回正，屁股上就冷不丁挨了一下。“嗷呜！”疼的他捂着屁股，直接跳了起来。周凯东手里捏着武装带，像个暴君似的，怒目训斥。“偷懒就是偷懒，还特么低血糖？”“五大三粗长得跟头熊一样，陆阳低血糖了我信，你低血糖，在这糊弄鬼呢？”“给我站好了，站直了，后脚掌悬空！别以为先前偷偷挪了位置我没瞧见，我余光一直盯着你们呢！”“所有人全部加十分钟，再有人偷懒再加，加到你们老实为止！”新兵们欲哭无泪，心里都快把孔垄给骂死了。同时也更加羡慕，被临时叫去出公差的陆阳和丁腾飞二人。那在食堂里吃好喝好，他们像个大傻子似的在旗台上站军姿，待遇简直上天入地。周凯东干脆也不走了，就站在后头盯着这帮家伙站军姿，时不时的还会从后面搞个偷袭。戳戳膝盖窝，掰掰手指头，谁屁股撅太高了，直接就是武装带伺候。当兵没有捷径，也不能偷懒，尤其是新兵连这三个月，更是泥胎塑形的重要阶段。如果出现瑕疵纰漏，那就是周凯东的不称职，是对部队的不负责。吊儿郎当，投机取巧，光想着偷懒的人，能手握钢枪肩负重任，全心全意保障老百姓的安全吗？显然是不能的！军人，必须脚踏实地！必须要有毅力有担当，不怕吃苦，且敢于吃苦。只有军人把该吃得苦都吃完了，老百姓才能免受战争的苦难。每一名优秀的军人，都是百炼成钢，都是吃了许许多多常人所不能承受的苦，才有如今成就。而现在，周凯东就是要通过各种手段，将这些稚气未脱的年轻人锤炼成，能够为老百姓遮蔽风雨的坚石。陆阳他是不担心的，这小子心性比同龄人更老成，更加清晰的明白自已要什么，目标也很明确，所以能比其他人更加沉下心去训练学习。孔垄问题其实也好解决，本身就有运动健身的底子，只要体重下来各项训练立马就能迎来突破。班里其他人也都在缓慢前进，一点点往兵的模样靠拢，而他唯一担心的也就只有丁腾飞。这小子坏的不彻底，好的不持续，脑瓜子还像个二手地摊货，实在是有些不灵光。不论是跑去跟指导员告状，泄密，还是在团领导面前给连长上眼药。这些在正常人看来蠢的不能再蠢的举动，偏偏这小子一个没落下。但凡是懂点儿人情世故，知道照顾点儿旁人情绪的，都干不出这么拉胯的事儿。但结合丁腾飞过往不好好念书，打架斗殴，和社会青年鬼混的经历仔细想想，好像这一切又挺合乎情理。毕竟，那个圈层大多缺乏管教，没什么文化，认知十分有限；再加上扭曲的三观，崇尚暴力的环境氛围，塑造出什么奇形怪状的人都不奇怪。这类人喜欢把读书无用论放在嘴边，张口闭口就是创业就是做生意。但殊不知，读书的最终目的并非只是考大学，找工作；而是开格局，阔眼界，明事理。三个月的时间，周凯东不奢求能把丁腾飞带的多优秀，只希望他能多跟他那个老乡学学好。别给部队添乱，别给老百姓添乱，别给军人这两个字抹黑就足够了。......“哎，终于全部干完了，累死爹了！”“走吧，去喝甜汤。”“你先去，我把地扫一下，丢个垃圾就来。”“行。”剩下一点儿扫尾工作，丁腾飞主动承包。但说话时候却遮遮掩掩，不知道在搞什么鬼？陆阳也没多想，简单洗了个手，他就去了前头大厅。桌上已经提前盛好了两碗汤在那，银耳汤炖的够火候甜甜润润，正适合干完儿口干舌燥的时候喝。陆阳喝完之后又厚着脸皮要了一碗，两碗都见底了却并没有瞧见丁腾飞过来？他刚找过去，就瞧见丁腾飞提着俩垃圾袋，鬼鬼祟祟的从仓库里出来。“站住！”“你手里提的什么东西？”喊话的并不是陆阳，而是先前那个上等兵。丁腾飞身子震了一下，然后拔腿就跑。上等兵见状，赶紧带人追上去。目睹这一幕的陆阳脑瓜子嗡嗡的，感觉整个人都不好了！......“站住！”“站住，别跑！”“偷东西，有人偷东西！”此时，旗台边的周凯东刚准备喊话休息，突然听见远处食堂那边突生骚乱。扭头看过去，只见几个炊事班老兵手里提溜着大勺，正在追赶前面那人。因为隔得有点远，他并没有看清前面那个提溜着俩垃圾袋，跟狗一样被追着跑的家伙是谁。直到他瞧见陆阳也从食堂追出来，并焦急的冲他用力挥手。周凯东这才反应过来，前头逃跑的那家伙，是丁腾飞！又来了，没完没了了是吗？不用问，准是丁腾飞偷了食堂什么东西被抓包了！他奶奶的，真是一刻不得安生，成天尽给老子惹事！
content_en: Although the flag stand is only 30 centimeters high, it is still very dangerous if you knock your head on the concrete floor.Kong Rong was suddenly startled by the feeling of weightlessness.But before he could react, his body was caught firmly in mid-air.Zhou Kaidong held him firmly and looked down at him with a smile. Kong Long stared with panicked eyes, not daring to look at him.The other recruits in the class were dumbfounded by this scene, fearing that a classic scene from a fairy tale would happen to them in the next second.Fortunately, the bloody scene did not happen, and everyone does not have to worry about being troubled by nightmares in the future."Give me, get up!" Zhou Kaidong stabilized his legs, combined his waist and horse and pushed hard.It was as if a large round wooden stake was erected from the ground, and the hole was erected back to the flag stand.After Kong Long stood firm, he quickly explained with lingering fear: "Squad leader, thank you. What, I, I have hypoglycemia." Zhou Kaidong said lightly that it was okay, and slowly touched his waist with his hands.Kong Long breathed a sigh of relief, and as soon as his head returned to normal, he received a sudden blow on his butt."Ouch!" He covered his butt in pain and jumped up.Zhou Kaidong held the armed belt in his hand and scolded him angrily like a tyrant."Being lazy is just being lazy, and you are so hypoglycemic?" "The five big and three thick ones are like a bear. I believe Lu Yang is hypoglycemic. Are you hypoglycemic, and are you fooling around here?" "Stand up, stand up straight, with the soles of your back feet in the air! Don't think that you should do it first.I didn't see you move your position secretly.I was keeping an eye on you all the time!" "Everyone, give me ten more minutes.If anyone is lazy, I will add more until you are honest!" The recruits were about to cry, and they almost cursed Kong Long to death.At the same time, he was even more envious of Lu Yang and Ding Tengfei, who were temporarily called out on a business trip.They eat and drink well in the canteen, they stand on the flag stand like a fool, and their treatment is as good as heaven and earth.Zhou Kaidong simply didn't leave. He just stood behind and stared at these guys in military positions, and would make sneak attacks from behind from time to time.Poke the knee joints, rub your fingers, and if your butt is too high, you will be immediately served with an armed belt.There are no shortcuts to being a soldier, and you can't be lazy, especially the three months of the new recruit company, which is an important stage for shaping the clay tires.If there are flaws or omissions, it would be Zhou Kaidong's incompetence and irresponsibility for the troops.Can people who are idle, opportunistic, and just thinking about laziness hold a steel gun in their hands and shoulder heavy responsibilities and protect the safety of the people wholeheartedly?Obviously not!Soldiers must be down-to-earth!You must have perseverance and responsibility, not be afraid of hardship, and dare to endure hardship.Only when soldiers eat up all the hardships they deserve can the common people be spared the suffering of war.Every outstanding soldier has been refined into steel over hundreds of times. He has endured many hardships that ordinary people cannot bear to achieve what he has achieved today.Now, Zhou Kaidong wants to use various means to temper these naive young people into a solid rock that can protect the people from wind and rain.Lu Yang is not worried. This kid is more mature than his peers. He understands what he wants more clearly and has clear goals, so he can train and study with more concentration than others.The problem of pores and ridges is actually easy to solve. You have a foundation in sports and fitness. As long as you lose weight, you will immediately have a breakthrough in various trainings.Everyone else in the class was also moving forward slowly, getting closer to the soldiers, but the only one he worried about was Ding Tengfei.This guy's bad deeds are not complete, his good deeds are not continuous, and his mind is like a second-hand street vendor. He is really not very smart.Whether it was running to complain to the instructor, leaking secrets, or applying eye drops to the company commander in front of the regiment leader.These actions that a normal person would consider extremely stupid, but this kid didn't miss any of them.Anyone who knows a little bit about the world and knows how to take care of other people's emotions would not be able to do such a crotch-stretching thing.But if you think about it carefully based on Ding Tengfei's past experience of not studying hard, getting into fights, and fooling around with young people in society, it seems that all this is quite reasonable.After all, most of that circle lacks discipline, has no culture, and has very limited cognition; coupled with distorted views and an environment that advocates violence, it is not surprising that some weird people have been created.This kind of people like to talk about the futility of studying, and talk about starting a business or doing business.But as everyone knows, the ultimate goal of studying is not just to get into college and find a job; it is to open up a new situation, broaden your horizons, and understand things.In three months, Zhou Kaidong did not expect to make Ding Tengfei more outstanding. He only hoped that he could learn more from his fellow countryman.It is enough not to cause trouble to the troops, not to cause trouble to the common people, and not to discredit the word "soldiers"...."Hey, I'm finally done. I'm so tired!" "Let's go and have sweet soup." "You go first, I'll sweep the floor and throw away the garbage." "Okay." There was a little bit of cleaning work left, and Ding Tengfei took the initiative to take over it.But when he spoke, he was secretive, wondering what he was doing?Lu Yang didn't think much, simply washed his hands and went to the front hall.Two bowls of soup have been placed on the table in advance. The white fungus soup has been simmered for a long time, is sweet and moist, and is just right to drink when you have a dry mouth after doing it.After Lu Yang finished drinking, he shamelessly asked for another bowl. Both bowls were bottomed out but he didn't see Ding Tengfei coming?As soon as he looked for it, he saw Ding Tengfei sneaking out of the warehouse carrying two garbage bags."Stop!" "What are you carrying in your hand?" It was not Lu Yang who shouted, but the superior soldier from before.Ding Tengfei was shaken, and then ran away.Upon seeing this, the superior soldier quickly led his men to catch up.Lu Yang's head was buzzing after witnessing this scene, and he felt bad all over!..."Stop!" "Stop, don't run!" "Steal something, someone stole something!" At this time, Zhou Kaidong at the flag stand was just about to call for a break when he suddenly heard a sudden commotion in the canteen in the distance.Turning around and looking over, I saw a few veterans of the cooking class chasing the man in front of them with large spoons in their hands.Because he was a little far away, he didn't see clearly who the guy in front of him was, carrying two garbage bags and being chased like a dog.Until he saw Lu Yang chasing him out of the cafeteria and waving to him anxiously.Only then did Zhou Kaidong realize that the guy running away in front was Ding Tengfei!Here we go again, never ending, right?No need to ask, Ding Tengfei must have been caught stealing something from the canteen!His grandma really can't live in peace for a moment, causing me trouble all day long!
